scoreboard.name: FOREVER RIDE
scoreboard.desc: the control — current live behavior: hold up to 10, fixed target, ride to hit/stop
scoreboard.kill_criterion: after 40 closed trades, if delta_vs_hodl < sleeve A's, this variation is disproven for now

scoreboard.name: CAP ONLY
scoreboard.desc: concentration alone: hold 5 best, bigger slices, same fixed target
scoreboard.kill_criterion: after 40 closed trades, if delta_vs_hodl < sleeve A's, this variation is disproven for now

scoreboard.name: FULL DISCIPLINE
scoreboard.desc: concentrate + recycle dead capital (accept ~-0.3% at 72h) + let winners ride on fast-green
scoreboard.kill_criterion: after 40 closed trades, if delta_vs_hodl < sleeve A's, this variation is disproven for now

scoreboard.name: SNIPER
scoreboard.desc: 2-3 max, confidence-gated entries only, ride hard, recycle ruthlessly — the full-prediction-stack sniper
scoreboard.kill_criterion: after 40 closed trades, if delta_vs_hodl < sleeve A's, this variation is disproven for now

what: A/B/C/D discipline lab — four isolated $10k sleeves on the crypto universe, same entry signals, differing ONLY in position management. A=current behavior (control). Judged Δ-vs-HODL and realized compounding, NOT win rate. The winner earns promotion to live.
how_to_read: Each sleeve holds a different max # of positions and exits differently. Watch delta_vs_hodl over ~40 closed trades: the discipline that compounds fastest wins. Never funds the Master; pure measurement.
